items: Automate repetitive service work such as replies to common reviews, triage of high-risk feedback, survey follow-ups and basic questions about hours or delivery status.
Keep people on emotional recovery, escalations with upset guests and brand voice moments, where a real apology or personal touch matters most.
Make automated replies feel human by using natural language, adding context like the location or order, and escalating the right issues to the right people.
For multi-location brands, AI provides consistent service systems so quality doesn't depend on one great manager at each location.
